header: Cliffwater is a leading authority on private debt, with over $100 billion in assets. But its website hadn’t kept up with its expertise. At Ghost Collective, we redesigned it to make its complex data clear and easy to trust. I was the design lead.

text: Private debt is dense and difficult to navigate for the average investor. Our goal was to make the data more accessible to new users without losing the detail that institutional clients demand. We focused on clear layouts and modular components to help users parse large amounts of information.

Beyond the data, we designed for first impressions. On every page, we put ourselves in the shoes of customers looking at the site for the first time. Who is this company, and do they seem trustworthy?

We developed a visual language to represent the layered nature of private debt. Instead of standard icons, we created geometric illustrations that mirror how assets are structured. They give the site a consistent way to show abstract ideas, from fund overviews to detailed performance data, and make technical information easier to grasp without losing a professional tone.
What began as a website update grew into a broader brand system. The result is a quiet, confident identity that earns trust through accuracy, not trends.
